name: Veggie Ground, Roasted Potato, Bell Pepper & Mushroom Frittata

cookwares.name: stainless steel or cast iron skillet

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ lb new potatoes
3 red bell peppers
1 ½ lb white mushrooms

instructions.primary_message: Small dice new potatoes. Transfer a large baking sheet pan, drizzle with oil, then season with salt and pepper. Stir to coat and spread out in an even layer.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, stirring halfway through, until potatoes are golden and fork-tender, about 15-18 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, trim, seed, and slice bell peppers lengthwise into thin strips. Place in a large bowl.
Thinly slice mushrooms. Add to the bowl with the peppers and set aside.
Preheat a large ovenproof skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add veggie ground and cook, breaking it apart with a spoon, until browned and crumbly, 5-6 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
24 oz veggie ground, plant based

instructions.primary_message: While the veggie ground is cooking, peel and mince garlic. Add to the bowl with the vegetables.
When the veggie ground is done, add veggies, garlic, and spices to the skillet; cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, 7-8 minutes. Remove from heat. (Reserve bowl for the next step.)
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ tsp smoked paprika
1 ½ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, place eggs, salt, and pepper in the reserved bowl, then whisk to combine. Set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
18 eggs
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: When the potatoes are done, change oven to broil on high. Transfer potatoes to the skillet with the veggie ground and vegetables, then stir to combine.

Return skillet to medium-low heat and add the egg mixture. As eggs set around the edge of the skillet, gently lift cooked portions with a spatula to allow uncooked egg to flow underneath. Cook until bottom and sides are firm but top is still runny, 5-7 minutes.
Place skillet in the oven and broil until top is set, 4-5 minutes. Remove from oven.
To serve, cut frittata into wedges and divide between plates. Enjoy!
